prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
home, wait_info changes are helpful (+3.6% after noise correction across 2 winning tests).
adoption, redesign changes did not work, showing negative or no clear effect (-5.4% after noise correction across 2 tests).
Predictions remained inaccurate overall, overestimating early changes while underestimating significant later wins.
Evidence is still thin for finish, new_flow changes (only 1 test).
Evidence is still thin for choose_path changes (only 1 test each for redesign, reorder, and copy).
Evidence is still thin for sign_in changes (only 1 test each for reorder, notification, and hint).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +6.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -5.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +3.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

- home, wait_info: +3.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Path Selection Quiz Screen: Insert a new interactive quiz screen before path selection to help users determine whether a story, standard, or custom pet path fits them best. (why: choose_path has a 79.7% conversion rate with high mean time (514s), indicating user hesitation when picking a path.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Multi-Device Safeguard Notice: Add an explicit safeguard helper notice below sign-in options explaining that signing in links pets to the account to prevent reset or loss on re-login. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
2: [finish, new_flow] First Desktop Interaction Practice Flow: Introduce an interactive mini-practice tutorial module directly within the finish screen allowing users to try hiding and summoning a test desktop pet. (why: Support mailbox received 3 explicit complaints from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Reorder: Reorder the sign_in screen to occur right after adoption certificate approval so users bond with their pet before registering an account. (why: Moving account sign-in after pet adoption leverages commitment bias and improves overall funnel completion.)
4: [home, notification] Generation Completion Audio Cue Toggle: Add an optional audio chime notification toggle and visible alert banner on the waiting screen when pet rendering completes. (why: Home screen wait time has a high mean of 2336s, indicating users switch context and miss completion.)
5: [adoption, copy] Pet Trait and Behavior Summary Card: Update friend selection copy with clear behavior descriptions explaining pet personalities and desktop interaction styles. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the onboarding funnel (66.8%).)

scores.note: Choose_path has high mean duration (514s); interactive quiz requires creating new screens.
8 support emails corroborate sign_in pet reset issues, but sign_in hints previously yielded -1.0% lift.
Support emails and funnel back finish complaints; finish new_flow showed +11.7% lift in prior test.
Sign_in reorder yielded +12.4% lift in earlier testing; moderate effort to change screen order.
Home screen changes targeting wait times consistently win (+3.6%); requires UI/audio additions.
Adoption loses 33.2% of users (biggest funnel drop); copy updates are config-only.
